import json, random, subprocess, sys, os
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tools')
from refmodel import mask
from fuzz2 import make_prefixes
rng=random.Random(1)
prefixes = make_prefixes(rng)
ops = []
nops = rng.randint(5, 60)
for _ in range(nops):
    r = rng.random()
    if r < 0.45:
        value, length = rng.choice(prefixes); hop = rng.randint(0, 4194302)
        ops.append(["put", "%032x" % value, length, hop])
    elif r < 0.6:
        value, length = rng.choice(prefixes); ops.append(["query", ["%032x" % value]])
    elif r < 0.72:
        ops.append(["query", ["%032x" % rng.getrandbits(128)]])
    elif r < 0.82:
        ops.append(["save"])
    elif r < 0.92:
        ops.append(["load_saved", 0])
    else:
        ops.append(["image_query", ["%032x" % rng.getrandbits(128)]])
print("saves:", sum(1 for o in ops if o[0]=="save"), "loads:", sum(1 for o in ops if o[0]=="load_saved"))
req={"cases":[{"ops":ops}]}
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/workspace/run.py'],input=json.dumps(req).encode(),capture_output=True)
resp=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
print("snapshots:", len(resp['results'][0]['snapshots']))
EOF
